You are required to complete [ff6464]Mission Chapter 8:\nThe Former God of Justice[ffffff] to proceed.
Wahaha~, nice! It's full of god's treasures!!\nAdventurer, look! They are everywhere!!
Hey hey hey!\nI guess they all belong to Obligaus...
Hey...I don't think this is right.\nHe'd better stop before the god of\nthe previous generation shows up...
Oy! Who the heck are you?!\nHow dare you steal my properties!!
Oh? Humans...Trying to make money out of theft!\nThanks to you guys, I can't even find a glass\nto enjoy my alcohol!!
Just because I'm retired doesn't mean my power\nhas weakened.
Kya-Kyaaaa!!
Gyaaaa! Hey, take it out quickly!\nThe wine! The wine!
Oh, w-what is it?...Isn't it wine?\nAha, you got me.\nWhy didn't you tell me earlier...
What? I knew it as soon as I saw that weak boy.\nYou're here for an archeological investigation,\nright? Thanks for the wine!
You old codger!! You knew from the start\nhe's an archeologist, didn't you?\nWhy would you do such a prank?!
It's just that there have been too\nmany rude archaeologists these days.
After screwing up and stealing stuff, they just\nwent home without saying thank you...I'm sick\nof that. That's why I put on a scary face, sorry.
Well, as my apology, you can ask me anything.\nHave a seat.
...Thus, I handed over my duty as the God of\nJustice to Kunon and I'm watching over the ruins\nof the gods while living my retired life.
But recently, a strange thing happened...
W-what was it? Could it be the clo...cloister?\nI've read many books,\nbut none of them mention about it.
Obviously. It was just formed out of nowhere.
I've climbed midway up the cloister,\nit seems to connect the ruins of the gods' temples\nand strecthes all the way to another world...
The ruins of the gods' temples!\nCan it be seen if we climb up?!
Yeah...but, not even one god was there and\nit was devastating. It's just the same as\nlooking at ruins. Boring, right?
It's alright!! As long as I can touch the ruins\nthat the gods left behind at a place that\nhas never been visited by humans!!
Oh?...What is it? Did I miss something??
Unfortunately, it's been a custom since ancient\ntimes to prohibit commoners from passing\nthis place. Sorry for that.
No way~!!
However, there is a way...
Huh?! W-what is it...
Well, as promised, you may pass.
But don't climb too high!\nI've never been there either,\nso I don't know what's up there...
There might be a hole that leads to another world.\nYou're doomed if you get sucked in for approaching\nit...I won't feel good about it, so please!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing! Let's get out!
Explore the Ruins of Mt. Mithurna!
